name: Upstream Project Analysis
description: Separate upstream behavior from local modifications using the repo, releases, and changelog.

permissionsRequired.reason: See upstream history versus local commits.
See which files are locally modified.
Read the local diff before treating it as upstream behavior.
Read the file the change or diagnosis depends on.
Find official documentation for this software.
Read the official page a search result named.
Read a readme, changelog, or spec.

validation.rule: Upstream behavior and local modifications were distinguished using git or the changelog that was read.
